title: Trading alongside a prince
literal_meaning: The folly of dried-fish trading with a prince.
explanation: A person with fewer resources can suffer by joining someone whose means are much greater. The warning concerns an unequal undertaking.
meaning_odia: ବଡ଼ ସମ୍ବଳ ଥିବା ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଯେଉଁ କାମର ବିପଦ ଅଳ୍ପ, ଅଳ୍ପ ସମ୍ବଳର ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ସେହି ବିପଦ ବଡ଼ ହୋଇପାରେ। ରାଜପୁତ୍ର ଓ ବ୍ୟବସାୟର ଚିତ୍ରରେ ଏହି ଅସମାନ ସ୍ଥିତିକୁ ଭାବିହେବ। ମୁଖ୍ୟ କଥା ସମ୍ବଳ ଓ କ୍ଷତି ସମ୍ଭାଳିବାର ସାମର୍ଥ୍ୟ, ଜନ୍ମରୁ କିଏ ବଡ଼ ବା ଛୋଟ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: Friends plan an expensive outing without noticing that one cannot afford the shared costs. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: This follows the dictionary gloss; it is not a documented trading incident or a rule against friendships across income levels.

graphic.caption: The same venture, very different means.

odia_summary: ନିଜ ସାମର୍ଥ୍ୟଠାରୁ ବହୁତ ଅଧିକ ସାମର୍ଥ୍ୟ ଥିବା ଲୋକଙ୍କ ସହ ମାତିଲେ ନିଜେ ଅସୁବିଧାରେ ପଡ଼ିପାରେ।
english_summary: Joining an undertaking with someone far wealthier can put a person with fewer resources at risk.
